space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

harness.description: The harness the files came from, such as claude-code: a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, digits or dashes

project.description: A label such as a repository name, never a path. Without it the records belong to every project

entries.description: One entry per file, or per part of a file over 64 KiB

text.description: At most 64 KiB. Secrets are masked before it is stored

path.description: The file's path relative to the directory imported, with #p<k> for a part; never absolute

generated.description: Who generated the file's text and when, if the harness says

share.description: Who may read the records: private (you, the default), space or group:<g>. Widening needs a person or a listed writer
